data.name: The Underlayer
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to the Underlayer!

A simple trip to the bathroom becomes a journey through the bizarre worlds of the human psyche. Fight hordes of bizarre creatures, collect powerful weapons, defeat formidable bosses, and help Petka find his way back home... if there is such a thing as a home.

Explore the Living Underlayer

Each dimension reflects a different aspect of the human mind. Everyday objects come to life, familiar places become deadly labyrinths, and our strangest habits govern the world around us. You never know what awaits around the next corner.

Humor Everywhere

Petka is not a hero. He's lazy, sloppy, and overconfident. But his witty commentary on the situation makes even the most dire situations laughable.

Fast-Paced Combat

Use a variety of weapons, including experimental shotguns and automatic pistols crafted by the inhabitants of the Underlayer. Each fight demands quick movement, dodges, and careful positioning.

Defeat massive bosses.

A unique boss awaits you at the end of each dimension. Each boss has its own set of attacks, combat phases, and weaknesses. In order to progress to the next level of the Underside, you must defeat them.

Will you be able to escape?

The Underside is constantly evolving. Each new portal leads to an even more bizarre world. The only question is: can you find your way out before becoming a part of the madness?
